notes: L11-B2a: which own-room floor sets are live. A tier whose rooms have a floorSet uses only those rooms when the set is true here; when it is false the tier keeps the shared rooms. A set that is missing here, or not true, is off, and so is every set if this file is missing. Turn a tier 4-10 set on only after its 8 rooms are in content/rooms/ and its Guardian art is OK'd (L11-B2).
